ideas.pitch: A high-agility wireless rover optimized for navigating tight circuit turns and handling multi-elevation obstacles within strict dimension and weight constraints.
ideas.problem_statement: The Senior Robo Race challenges teams to design and build a manually controlled, wireless robot capable of navigating an obstacle-filled track and completing the entire circuit in the shortest possible time.
ideas.title: AeroFlex Speed Rover
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses on rapid traversal and obstacle handling under a continuously running clock, directly addressing the core evaluation criteria for speed and agility.
